shots.speaker: ANCHOR
shots.text: Former Prime Minister Balaceanu was found dead in his cell this morning. Preliminary findings: suicide.

shots.speaker: BIRIBEL
shots.text: Suicide. He didn't have the spine for it.

shots.speaker: PRESIDENT
shots.text: Parliament is suspended. KRAP is dissolved into my Presidential Guard - every one of you now answers to me.

shots.speaker: BIRIBEL
shots.text: Decree Number One. No more KRAP - I'm the President's man now. We all are.

shots.speaker: OLD SQUADMATE
shots.text: Same squad, new colours, Biribel. Y-3 intake - we've always covered each other. Right?

shots.speaker: QUARTERMASTER
shots.text: Tunic, armband, helmet. Sign for them. The blue goes in the bin, Biribel.

shots.speaker: BIRIBEL
shots.text: My whole unit in the President's black. If this turns, I'll be shooting at my friends.
